## 💡 My Solution

An intelligent real-time system combining:

1. **Live flight data** from Aviation Stack API
2. **Weather integration** from Open-Meteo  
3. **ML predictions** using Random Forest
4. **Interactive dashboard** for insights

All integrated into one production-ready application.

---

## 🔌 How It Works

```
 ✈️ Aviation Stack     Open-Meteo API
     (Flights)        (Weather Data)
         │                  │
         └──────┬───────────┘
                │
         📦 Python Pipeline
         • Data cleaning
         • Feature engineering
         • Real delay extraction
                │
         🎯 ML Training (Random Forest)
         • Hyperparameter tuning
         • Cross-validation
         • Residual analysis
                │
      🎨 R Shiny Dashboard + Report
```

---

## 📊 The Data

**897 flights** collected:
- **100** live real-time flights
- **797** historical (7-day lookback)
- **59** features per flight
- **97.9%** weather match rate

Real delays captured: **0-616 minutes** ⚠️

---

## 🌪️ Weather Matching

**Non-trivial integration:**
- 800+ flights matched to nearest hourly wind observation
- Temporal alignment across timezones
- 97.9% success rate

Wind speed range: **0.36 - 42 km/h**

---

## 🤖 Machine Learning

**Random Forest Regressor:**
- **637** training samples
- **160** test samples
- **20+** engineered features
- 5-fold cross-validation
- Hyperparameter tuning (grid search)

**Performance:** RMSE **8.4 minutes** 🎯

---

## 📈 What the Model Learned

- 🌅 **6-9 AM flights:** Most reliable (low variance)
- 🌆 **2-6 PM flights:** Highest delays & variance  
- 💨 **Wind impact:** Non-linear at extremes
- ✈️ **Airline patterns:** 15+ minute spread

---

**Performance Overview Tab:**
- Real-time delay metrics

**Weather Impact Tab:**

## 📉 Prediction Analysis

**Top Airlines (Most Reliable):**
- On-time leaders identified
- Departure delay predictions
- Residual error by airline

**Temporal Patterns:**
- Best/worst times to fly
- Hour-by-hour breakdown
- Actionable insights

## 📊 Analytics Report

Comprehensive Quarto report includes:
- Exploratory data analysis
- Airline rankings & statistics
- Weather-delay relationships
- Model performance metrics
- Interactive visualizations

**50+ pages of insights** 📄

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

| Component | Technology |
|-----------|-----------|
| **Data Pipeline** | Python 3.12, pandas |
| **APIs** | Aviation Stack, Open-Meteo |
| **ML Framework** | tidymodels + ranger |
| **Dashboard** | R Shiny + Plotly + DT |
| **Reporting** | Quarto + Markdown |
| **Automation** | Bash scripting |
